claims: Hydrocodone is an opioid analgesic used to treat severe chronic pain or severe cough.
Hydrocodone works by binding to CNS opioid receptors to change the body’s perception of pain.
Common side effects of Hydrocodone include nausea, dizziness, constipation, and drowsiness.
Hydrocodone can cause fatal respiratory depression.
Hydrocodone can cause dependency.
Vicodin is a common brand name for a combination of Hydrocodone with acetaminophen.
Lortab is a common brand name for a combination of Hydrocodone with acetaminophen.
Lorcet-HD is a common brand name for a combination of Hydrocodone with acetaminophen.
Hysingla ER is a common extended-release brand name for Hydrocodone.
Zohydro ER is a common extended-release brand name for Hydrocodone.
Hydrocodone is prescribed for moderate to severe pain when other treatments are insufficient.
Hydrocodone is prescribed for cough suppression.
Common side effects of Hydrocodone include constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, nausea, and vomiting.
Serious effects of Hydrocodone include severe respiratory depression.
Serious effects of Hydrocodone include liver injury if combined with acetaminophen.
Serious effects of Hydrocodone include hypotension.
Hydrocodone is a CNS depressant.
Hydrocodone works as an antitussive cough suppressor.
Hydrocodone reduces pain sensation in the brain.
Stopping Hydrocodone suddenly can cause withdrawal symptoms including anxiety, insomnia, nausea, tremors, and vomiting.
Hydrocodone can cause addiction and dependence.
Hydrocodone pills are often oval-shaped.
Hydrocodone pills are typically orange, white, or yellow.
Hydrocodone pills are labeled with their milligram dosage.
